name: Ford - Rawsonville Components Plant, Ypsilanti MI

fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link perimeter fence rings the property; closed double-swing vehicle gate on the SW (truck-yard) side and a rolling chain-link gate on the NE both confirmed in 2024-25 Street View.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at any gate in Street View - gates are plain chain-link, no booth structure beside the lane.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but unmanned (no booth) - kiosk / badge / app check-in implied.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on the SW building face and a separate dock/staging cluster on the SE building face - two distinct truck zones.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide unmarked paved aprons inside both gates leave room for an express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-township site bordered by Ford Lake and farmland to the south; small-town industrial setting -> Rural.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~1.7M sq ft sprawling 1950s plant; door count is an overhead estimate across multiple building faces.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single-lane chain-link gates; lane count low-confidence from overhead.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property; web research did not indicate rail service.
